name: 固定与高斯定时器联动

pre_processors.name: 准备 HTTP 参数
pre_processors.script: vars.put('item_id','42'); log.info('HTTP pre user={} iteration={}', ctx.getThreadNum(), vars.getIteration());

post_processors.name: 提取 HTTP 响应
post_processors.script: if (!prev.isSuccessful()) throw new Error('HTTP failed'); const data=JSON.parse(prev.getResponseDataAsString()); if(data.id !== 42) throw new Error('unexpected mock item'); vars.put('http_id',String(data.id)); log.info('HTTP post id={}', vars.get('http_id'));

children.name: JDBC 处理器联动
children.sql: SELECT $1::integer AS id, current_database()::text AS database

pre_processors.name: 准备 SQL 绑定参数
pre_processors.script: if(vars.get('http_id') !== '42') throw new Error('missing HTTP variable'); vars.put('query_id',vars.get('http_id')); log.info('JDBC pre id={}',vars.get('query_id'));

post_processors.name: 提取 JDBC 响应
post_processors.script: if(!prev.success) throw new Error('JDBC failed'); const data=JSON.parse(prev.body); if(data.rows[0][0] !== 42 || data.rows[0][1] !== 'ipds_dev') throw new Error('unexpected database result'); vars.put('db_id',String(data.rows[0][0])); log.info('JDBC post id={}',vars.get('db_id'));

children.name: JavaScript 处理器联动
children.script: if(vars.get('phase') !== 'prepared' || vars.get('db_id') !== '42') throw new Error('chain failed'); vars.put('phase','sampled'); log.info('JavaScript main');

post_processors.name: 检查 JavaScript 结果
post_processors.script: if(!prev.isSuccessful() || prev.body !== null || vars.get('phase') !== 'sampled') throw new Error('invalid result'); vars.put('phase','finished'); log.info('JavaScript post');
